mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing fair conditions near Harriet Park with temperatures at 70 degrees, and with the time past 5 PM, the overnight low is N/A with no rain expected.

There is plenty to do this weekend, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market and live music at Baileys Run today, followed by the John Denver tribute show at the Verona Area High School Fine Arts Center tomorrow.
